verdict.rationale: Cooley's IP litigation practice page concretely details patent, trademark and trade-secret litigation with specific venues and outcomes: 575+ patent cases, 80+ Federal Circuit appeals, 13 patent trials, 475+ PTAB proceedings, and 30+ Section 337 ITC investigations; trade-secret litigation is separately documented, and trademark protection work spans nearly 200 countries. Missing for 10: named case outcomes/decisions rather than aggregate statistics, and independent (non-firm) corroboration of litigation results.
